CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff liaison

  Wednesday, January 15th, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Jen Sancen, Senior Companion Director, Aging Next

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – October 16th, 2024

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Bingo Report – George Borst
  c. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  d. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  e. Mt. SAC Classes Update- Armando Cisneros
  f. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  g. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  h. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen

  5. PUBLIC COMMENT
   Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee meeting will be
  held at 10:00 a.m. on February 19th at the La Verne City Community Center, 3680 D Street,
  La Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On January 9th, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, January 15, 2024.

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, January 15, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Scott Snider, Terry Kistler,
  George Borst, Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent:

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Community Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, October 16th meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Jen Sancen, Senior Companion Director, Aging Next.

3. Jen Sancen of Aging Next presented an overview of the Care Partners program
  at Aging Next. As stated in their pamphlet, “We recruit special volunteers, who
  are active seniors living on a fixed income.” To visit isolated seniors in their
  homes. Senior Companions help to prevent loneliness and isolation, help with
  trips to stores, doctor offices, and much more. They also become friends for life
  in some cases.

  Unfinished Business

4. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 497 meals were served to an average of 23 participants in
  October. 458 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in the
  November. 425 meals were served to an average of 22 participants in December.

  Meals on Wheels: 572 meals were served/delivered in October. 521 meals
  were served/delivered in November. 534 meals were served/delivered in
  December.

5. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through December 2024 was
  $900. Liabilities to Bingo West were $470. Liabilities to the City of La Verne,
  $442. The average attendance for December was 52 players per week.
 6. Account Balance: $4,095.82.

7. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for except for Bridge.

8. MT. SAC Classes: Mt. SAC classes are currently in the winter session and will be
  ending on February 14th.

9. Aging Next: 5 La Verne residents were served in October with 4 served via
  the Joslyn Center and 1 served via Aging Next office. 8 La Verne residents
  were served in November with 1 served via the Joslyn Center and 7 served
  via Aging Next office. 5 La Verne residents were served in December with 2
  served via Joslyn Center and 3 served through Aging Next office.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: None.

11. Upcoming Events:

  •  Tuesday, February 4th – Excursion, Getty Center 9:00AM-4:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, February 5th – Senior Seminar, Alternative Funding Options to Age in Place, Presented by
  Change Home Mortgage, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, February 10th – Movie Matine, Ticket to Paradise, 12:30PM.
  •  Friday, February 14th – Senior Seminar, Using Home Equity to Stay at Home, Presented by Longbridge
  Financial, 9:30AM.

  Public Comments: Scott Snider presented the January Events at Hillcrest. You
  may find more information at LiveAtHillcrest.org. Scott mentioned Hillcrest has
  taken in 8 residents that were displaced from the nursing home in Altadena
  during the fires. Bette Donovan mentioned we should be coming up on voting
  for the Volunteer of the year.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:40AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, February 19, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
